runtime_experiment.proposal: For changed cooccurrence membership, use a u16-domain bounded bitset only when requested bit payload is no larger than the active-index u16 payload; retain HashSet for sparse historical indices. Keep the prior unchanged-membership cache.
runtime_experiment.validation: 26 history release cases pass, two manual fixtures ignored; strict all-targets release Clippy passes. Extended original-algorithm/shared-hash-builder oracle covers compact and sparse/wrapped index domains, duplicates, membership churn and exact pair-table iteration. Candidate source and binary retained with receipts.
runtime_experiment.scope: Cached hash-set pruning and bounded-bitset pruning in the same retained release test binary, with a common History layout. 500 entities, 100 samples per child; stable, reordered, compact-index churn and high-index churn workloads. Common setup validates counts and exact table iteration order with a shared hash builder. Not an app-wide comparison.
runtime_experiment.memory_scope: wait4 maximum process RSS includes common setup, both state-oracle histories and canonical-output encoding. It cannot isolate retained-cache or helper memory savings.
runtime_experiment.decision: Reject this first version: compact churn CPU improves 34.9%, but the steady fixture CPU rises 19.3% and maximum-process RSS also rises. The stable hot path was intended to be unchanged. A future attempt requires investigating compiler/call context and remeasurement; favorable churn alone does not establish a net improvement. Restored exact preceding production source; no source changes from this experiment remain.

build_experiment.proposal: Use the retained actual release UI frontend command to compare the original storage audit helper against an inline(never) candidate, in four matched ABBA optimized object compilations. Preserve optimization, sources/imports and two frontend threads; use fresh private module caches/outputs. Restore original source in finally. No compiler backend/default change.
build_experiment.scope: UI object compilation diagnostic only; excludes separate module emission, dependencies, linking, packaging, runtime and whole CI. A retained annotation additionally needs app/default-build compatibility and footprint validation.
